rationale: With only 24 minutes to close and forced liquidation at market, the risk/reward is unfavorable: the stock is already up ~23% on the day, sitting at 94.2% of its range near the session high, with a wide 36-bps spread that eats into any short-term edge. The 1-minute candles show choppy, indecisive price action with no clear directional momentum, and the ATR of ~$1.04 on 5-minute bars means a meaningful stop requires significant room that the time constraint doesn't allow to develop into a profitable move.
